records.subject: Welcome aboard, Union Dynamics
records.body:
Hi Tunde,

Thanks for joining Wrenfield. If this is your first project-management tool for the team, the biggest adjustment is usually just getting into the habit of logging tasks here instead of a doc or a chat thread.

Happy to help with that transition.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: First project reached day 1 (2026-08-01) but nothing since; 5 quiet days, no invite sent, no reply to welcome email [email:a414be3e], no tickets. Single-user Starter account with early momentum but current silence; 8 days left gives some chance of self-serve activation.

draft.subject: Next step after your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Tunde,

Nice work getting your first project set up last week. Projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so the usual next step is logging a few real tasks in that project rather than keeping them in a doc or chat thread.

When you're ready to bring the rest of the team in, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I can walk through how your team's work is structured and where it best fits.

Best,
Chidi
